lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's Clears St. Lucie Planning, Fueling Indrio Road Growth Wave
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's travel center at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road in northern St. Lucie County has completed the county's planning process and now needs only final approvals from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can begin. The 76,000-square-foot travel center would feature approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida, with the company previously targeting a 2028 opening.
